title: Looking after a garden
topic: Two people are talking in a garden. Which flowers will the woman water?
levelRationale: N5-oriented polite everyday speech with simple requests, time/place expressions and explicit contrasts. Follow the announced focus rather than remembering every detail. Vocabulary tips identify potentially unfamiliar spoken words; this is not an official JLPT vocabulary or difficulty certification.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 話を聞いて、質問の答えを一つ選んでください。
turns.translation: Listen and choose one answer to the question.

turns.speaker: n
turns.text: 庭で二人が話しています。女の人は、どの花に水をやりますか。
turns.translation: Two people are talking in a garden. Which flowers will the woman water?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 明日から二日間、留守にします。朝、花に水をやってもらえますか。
turns.translation: I'll be away for two days starting tomorrow. Could you water the flowers in the morning?

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: いいですよ。庭に花がたくさんありますね。全部に水をやるんですか。
turns.translation: Of course. There are a lot of flowers in the garden. Should I water all of them?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: いいえ、今夜は雨です。外にある花は大丈夫です。屋根の下の花だけお願いします。
turns.translation: No. It will rain tonight. The flowers out in the open will be fine. Just the ones under the roof, please.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 屋根の下ですね。白い花と黄色い花がありますが、両方ですか。
turns.translation: Under the roof, right. There are white and yellow flowers. Both?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 黄色い花には、今、水をやりました。白い花には、まだやっていません。
turns.translation: I've just watered the yellow flowers. I haven't watered the white ones yet.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: じゃ、白い花だけにします。水は台所から持って来ればいいですか。
turns.translation: Then I'll water just the white flowers. Should I bring water from the kitchen?

options.label: 庭の花全部
options.translation: All the flowers in the garden.
options.rationale: He explicitly limits the request rather than asking for all flowers.

options.label: 外にある黄色い花
options.translation: Yellow flowers out in the open.
options.rationale: Rain will reach the exposed flowers, and yellow is not the requested color.

options.label: 屋根の下の白い花
options.rationale: The roof excludes rain, and these have not been watered yet.

explanation: Combine location with the already/not-yet distinction. Only the sheltered white flowers still need the requested watering.
